types.label: Asphalt shingle

components.label: Architectural shingles
components.explain: 3 bundles per square; add more waste on cut-up roofs with many hips and valleys

components.label: Synthetic underlayment
components.explain: one 10-square roll per 10 squares, plus laps

components.label: Ice and water shield, eaves
components.explain: one 3 ft course along every eave (two courses where code needs 24 in inside the wall line); ~65 ft net per 2-square roll

components.label: Ice and water shield, valleys and walls
components.explain: a 3 ft strip centred in every valley; a half-width strip up walls is good practice

components.label: Starter strip shingles
components.explain: along every eave and rake; a bundle runs about 100-120 ft

components.label: Drip edge
components.explain: 10 ft pieces along every eave and rake, overlapped 2 in

components.label: Hip and ridge cap shingles
components.explain: one bundle covers about 20-33 ft depending on product; 25 ft is a safe planning figure

components.label: Shingle-over ridge vent
components.explain: 4 ft sections along the ridge, stopping short of the ends; skip if the house uses other exhaust

components.label: W-valley metal (open valleys)
components.explain: only for open valleys; closed-cut and woven valleys use ice and water shield instead

components.label: Step flashing
components.explain: one piece per shingle course (~5 in exposure) up sidewalls and chimney sides; a bundle of 100 does ~40 ft

components.label: Headwall / apron flashing
components.explain: continuous L-flashing along headwalls and the chimney front

components.label: Chimney counterflashing
components.explain: reglet or surface-mounted counterflashing over step and apron flashing at chimneys

components.label: Coil roofing nails (1-1/4 in)
components.explain: 4 nails per shingle (6 in high-wind zones); a 7,200-count box does ~20 squares including starter and caps

components.label: Plastic cap nails for underlayment
components.explain: a 2,000-3,000 count pail fastens the underlayment on a typical whole roof

components.label: Roofing sealant
components.explain: for flashings, nail heads at caps and boots; about one tube per 10 squares

components.label: Pipe boots
components.explain: one per plumbing vent; count from the inspection

components.label: Static roof vents / exhaust vents
components.explain: only where ridge vent is not used; count from the inspection

components.label: Intake vents (soffit or edge)
components.explain: balance exhaust with intake per IRC R806; count or footage from the inspection

sources: GAF Timberline HDZ / Pro-Start / Seal-A-Ridge application instructions
Owens Corning Duration shingle and starter application instructions
ARMA Residential Asphalt Roofing Manual
IRC R905.2 (asphalt shingles), R903 flashing, R806 ventilation

types.label: Wood shake

components.label: Cedar shakes (24 in)
components.explain: about 5 bundles per square at a 10 in exposure (4 bundles at 7.5 in for 18 in shakes plan as more)

components.label: Starter course (doubled first course)
components.explain: the first course at every eave is doubled, usually with 15 or 18 in shakes/shingles

components.label: 18 in #30 felt interlayment strips
components.explain: one 18 in strip of #30 felt laid between every course of shakes (~120 ft per square at 10 in exposure); roll lengths vary

components.label: Underlayment over solid sheathing
components.explain: breathable synthetic or felt over solid sheathing where used; not needed over spaced sheathing

components.label: Ventilating mat under shakes
components.explain: a drainage/ventilation mat that lets shakes dry on solid decks; rolls cover about 4 squares

components.label: Spaced sheathing boards (1x4 / 1x6)
components.explain: boards spaced to the exposure, about 120 ft per square; 16 ft pieces. Only when re-decking with spaced boards

components.label: Ice and water shield, eaves
components.explain: required at eaves in ice-dam regions; ~65 ft net per 2-square roll

components.label: Factory hip and ridge units
components.explain: pre-assembled hip and ridge; a bundle runs about 16-20 ft at a 10 in exposure

components.label: Ridge vent for wood roofs
components.explain: 4 ft sections under the ridge units where the attic is vented at the ridge

components.label: Drip edge
components.explain: not required by CSSB but common and required by some local codes

components.label: Valley flashing (24 in W-valley)
components.explain: metal valley at least 20 in wide with a centre crimp; wood roofs always use open metal valleys

components.label: Step flashing (large)
components.explain: one piece per course (~10 in exposure) up sidewalls and chimney sides; 100 pieces do ~50 ft

components.label: Headwall / apron flashing
components.explain: continuous apron flashing along headwalls and the chimney front

components.label: Chimney counterflashing
components.explain: counterflashing over the step and apron flashing

components.label: Stainless ring-shank nails or staples
components.explain: 2 fasteners per shake (~350 per square); a pneumatic box of ~3,000-3,600 does ~9 squares. Type 316 stainless near salt water

components.label: Roofing sealant
components.explain: only at flashings and penetrations; wood roofs use little sealant

components.label: Pipe flashings (lead or metal)
components.explain: one per plumbing vent; count from the inspection

components.label: Static exhaust vents
components.explain: only where ridge vent is not used

sources: Cedar Shake & Shingle Bureau (CSSB) New Roof Construction manual and installation guides
IRC R905.8 (wood shakes)
Benjamin Obdyke Cedar Breather installation guide

types.label: Standing seam metal

components.label: Standing seam panels (snap-lock or mechanical seam)
components.explain: panels are cut to length per run; order by area plus waste for hips, valleys and offcuts

components.label: High-temperature synthetic underlayment
components.explain: metal gets hot: use a high-temp rated (240-260 F) underlayment over the whole deck; 10 squares per roll

components.label: High-temperature ice and water barrier, eaves and valleys
components.explain: high-temp self-adhered membrane along eaves and centred in valleys; regular ice and water melts under metal

components.label: High-temperature self-adhered underlayment, full coverage
components.explain: upgrade or warranty requirement: self-adhered over the whole deck instead of synthetic; 2 squares per roll

components.label: Slip sheet (rosin paper)
components.explain: loose sheet between self-adhered underlayment and panels so panels can move; ~500 sq ft rolls

components.label: Standing seam clips
components.explain: about 1 clip every 2 ft along each panel seam (closer at eaves, rakes and ridges); ~40 per square, boxes of 100

components.label: Pancake-head clip screws
components.explain: 2 screws per clip; a box of 250 does about 3 squares

components.label: Eave cleat / hook strip
components.explain: continuous cleat along the eave that the panel hem locks onto

components.label: Eave trim / drip edge
components.explain: brake-formed or stock eave trim along every eave

components.label: Rake / gable trim
components.explain: rake trim along every gable edge, usually with a rake cleat

components.label: Rake cleat
components.explain: continuous cleat that holds the rake trim hem; some profiles fasten the trim directly

components.label: Ridge cap
components.explain: ridge cap over Z-closures along every ridge

components.label: Hip cap
components.explain: hip cap over Z-closures along every hip

components.label: Z-closures at ridge and hips
components.explain: a Z-closure on each side of every ridge and hip (two runs per foot), sealed to the panel

components.label: Vented ridge closure / ridge vent filter
components.explain: vented closures in place of solid Z-closures where the attic exhausts at the ridge

components.label: Valley pan with hemmed edges
components.explain: a formed valley pan in every valley, with valley cleats or Z-closures for the panel ends

components.label: Sidewall flashing
components.explain: continuous sidewall trim along walls and chimney sides (metal does not use step flashing)

components.label: Headwall / endwall flashing
components.explain: endwall flashing over Z-closures along headwalls and the chimney front

components.label: Counterflashing / reglet
components.explain: counterflashing over sidewall and endwall trim on masonry or where siding is not removed

components.label: Butyl tape sealant
components.explain: under every closure and trim lap: both sides of ridges, hips and valleys plus eaves, rakes and walls; 45 ft rolls

components.label: Urethane / metal-roof sealant
components.explain: for trim laps, closures and penetrations; about one tube per 8 squares

components.label: Pop rivets
components.explain: for trim laps and closures; a box of 250 usually does a whole roof

components.label: Trim / stitch screws
components.explain: about 1 painted screw per foot of trim and cap; a bag of 250 does ~200 ft

components.label: Retrofit pipe flashings
components.explain: EPDM or silicone retrofit boot with flexible base for each pipe; placed in the panel flat, never across a seam

components.label: Snow guards / snow retention
components.explain: clamp-on snow retention in snow regions; count from a layout

components.label: Chimney cricket / diverter
components.explain: behind chimneys wider than 30 in

sources: Metal Construction Association (MCA) and SMACNA Architectural Sheet Metal Manual
Manufacturer installation manuals: Englert, Drexel Metals, McElroy Metal, Sheffield Metals, Petersen PAC-CLAD
Underlayment manufacturers' high-temperature product guides (e.g. Grace Ultra, Polyglass, Sharkskin)
IRC R905.10 (metal roof panels)

types.label: Exposed-fastener metal (corrugated / R-panel)

components.label: Exposed-fastener panels (R-panel / corrugated)
components.explain: panels are 36 in coverage cut to length; order by area plus waste for end laps and cut-up areas

components.label: High-temperature synthetic underlayment
components.explain: over solid decks, a high-temp synthetic over the whole roof; 10 squares per roll. Barns over purlins often skip it

components.label: High-temperature ice and water barrier, eaves and valleys
components.explain: high-temp self-adhered along eaves and centred in valleys in ice-dam regions

components.label: Purlins / battens (1x4 or 2x4)
components.explain: only when installing over old shingles or on purlins: rows 24 in on centre, ~50 ft per square, 16 ft pieces

components.label: Panel screws with EPDM washers
components.explain: about 75-80 screws per square in the flat beside the rib at each purlin/row; bags of 250

components.label: Lap stitch screws
components.explain: short stitch screws along side laps and trim; bags of 250 do ~10 squares

components.label: Inside foam closures at eave
components.explain: a profiled foam closure under the panels along every eave; each closure covers one 3 ft panel

components.label: Outside foam closures at ridge and hips
components.explain: a profiled closure on each side of ridges and hips; 3 ft each

components.label: Vented ridge closures
components.explain: vented closures in place of solid ones where the attic exhausts at the ridge

components.label: Eave trim / drip edge
components.explain: along every eave

components.label: Rake / gable trim
components.explain: along every gable edge

components.label: Ridge cap
components.explain: along every ridge

components.label: Hip cap
components.explain: along every hip

components.label: Valley flashing
components.explain: formed valley in every valley with closures or butyl at the panel ends

components.label: Sidewall flashing
components.explain: continuous sidewall trim along walls and chimney sides

components.label: Endwall / headwall flashing
components.explain: endwall trim over outside closures along headwalls and the chimney front

components.label: Butyl tape sealant
components.explain: under closures and at end laps; 45 ft rolls

components.label: Side-lap sealant tape
components.explain: only on low slopes (under 3:12): a bead in every side lap, about 33 ft per square

components.label: Metal-roof sealant
components.explain: for trim laps and penetrations; about one tube per 8 squares

components.label: Trim screws
components.explain: about 1 screw per foot of trim; a bag of 250 does ~200 ft

components.label: Retrofit pipe flashings
components.explain: EPDM or silicone retrofit boot for each pipe

components.label: Touch-up paint
components.explain: matching paint pen or can for scratches

sources: Metal Construction Association (MCA) exposed-fastener guidance
Manufacturer installation guides: Metal Sales, Union Corrugating, Pro-Panel/MBCI, Fabral
IRC R905.10 (metal roof panels)

types.label: Stone-coated steel

components.label: Stone-coated steel panels
components.explain: about 22-28 panels per square depending on profile (tile, shake, shingle); check the profile's coverage

components.label: Synthetic underlayment
components.explain: synthetic or #30 felt over the whole deck; 10 squares per roll

components.label: Ice and water barrier, eaves and valleys
components.explain: self-adhered along eaves and in valleys in ice-dam regions

components.label: Battens (1x4 / 2x2)
components.explain: batten systems only: one row per course (~14-15 in), ~83 ft per square, 10 ft pieces. Direct-to-deck profiles skip it

components.label: Eave starter / eave closure
components.explain: profile-matched eave starter or closure along every eave; ~4 ft pieces

components.label: Rake / barge cover
components.explain: stone-coated rake cover along every gable edge; ~4 ft pieces

components.label: Ridge and hip caps
components.explain: stone-coated caps along ridges and hips; ~16-17 in exposure per piece

components.label: Vented ridge / ridge vent
components.explain: vented ridge system under the caps where the attic exhausts at the ridge

components.label: Valley flashing
components.explain: a valley tray in every valley

components.label: Sidewall flashing
components.explain: pan-style sidewall flashing along walls and chimney sides

components.label: Headwall / apron flashing
components.explain: headwall flashing along headwalls and the chimney front

components.label: Ring-shank nails or screws
components.explain: 4-5 fasteners per panel, ~120 per square; a box of 1,000 does ~8 squares

components.label: Sealant
components.explain: for flashings and caps; about one tube per 10 squares

components.label: Stone chip / touch-up kit
components.explain: coating and loose stone chips for cut edges and scuffs; one kit usually does a whole roof

components.label: Pipe flashings (lead or flexible)
components.explain: lead or flexible-base flashing dressed over the panel profile, one per pipe

sources: DECRA Metal Roofing installation manuals (Tile, Shake, Shingle; direct-to-deck and batten systems)
Westlake Royal (Boral) stone-coated steel installation guides; Tilcor installation guide
IRC R905.10 / manufacturer evaluation reports

types.label: Concrete / clay tile

components.label: Field tiles (concrete or clay)
components.explain: ordered by the square (~90 flat/S concrete tiles; ~150-170 two-piece clay barrel); more waste on hips

components.label: Tile underlayment (heavy-duty synthetic or 2-ply felt)
components.explain: tile outlives normal underlayment: use a tile-rated synthetic or two plies of #30; 10 squares per synthetic roll

components.label: Self-adhered high-temp tile underlayment
components.explain: regional (Florida, high wind) or upgrade: self-adhered tile underlayment over the whole deck; 2 squares per roll

components.label: Ice and water barrier, eaves and valleys
components.explain: in ice-dam regions along eaves and centred in valleys

components.label: Battens
components.explain: one row per course (~13.5 in), ~89 ft per square, 8 ft pieces. Required on steep slopes and in some regions; direct-deck otherwise

components.label: Counter-battens
components.explain: vertical strips under the battens for drainage, ~16-24 in on centre (~25 ft per square)

components.label: Eave closure / bird stop
components.explain: raises the first course and closes the tile profile along every eave

components.label: Drip edge
components.explain: along every eave and rake under the underlayment

components.label: Rake tiles
components.explain: one rake tile per course (~13-14 in) along every gable edge

components.label: Ridge and hip tiles
components.explain: trim tiles lapped along ridges and hips; ~14 in exposure per piece

components.label: Ridge and hip nailer board / raiser
components.explain: a wood or metal nailer along every ridge and hip to fasten the trim tiles

components.label: Ridge and hip closure roll (vented)
components.explain: flexible closure under ridge and hip tiles in place of mortar; vented where the attic exhausts at the ridge

components.label: Tile nails or screws
components.explain: 1-2 corrosion-resistant fasteners per tile (~90-180 per square); boxes vary, plan ~5 squares per box

components.label: Foam tile adhesive
components.explain: alternative or supplement to nails (common in Florida): one canister sets about 1-2 squares; follow the adhesive's paddy pattern

components.label: Tail / storm clips
components.explain: high-wind and coastal areas: a clip at the nose of each tile; boxes of ~500

components.label: Tile valley metal (24 in, ribbed)
components.explain: wide valley metal with water diverter ribs in every valley

components.label: Sidewall pan / channel flashing
components.explain: channel flashing under the tile along walls and chimney sides

components.label: Flexible headwall flashing (lead or self-adhering)
components.explain: dressed over the tile profile along headwalls and the chimney front; ~16.5 ft rolls

components.label: Counterflashing
components.explain: counterflashing over pan and headwall flashing

components.label: Tile sealant / mastic
components.explain: for flashings, ridge ends and penetrations; about one tube per 8 squares

components.label: Tile pipe flashings (primary and secondary)
components.explain: a deck flashing under the underlayment plus a lead or flexible flashing dressed over the tile, one set per pipe

components.label: Off-ridge tile vents
components.explain: tile-profile vents where ridge venting is not used

components.label: Mortar for ridges and rakes
components.explain: only where trim tiles are mortar-set instead of a closure roll; one 80 lb bag does roughly 10 ft

sources: Tile Roofing Industry Alliance (TRI) / FRSA Concrete and Clay Roof Tile Installation Manual
Manufacturer guides: Eagle Roofing, Westlake Royal (Boral), Ludowici, Crown
Foam adhesive manufacturers' application guides (e.g. DuPont Tile Bond, ICP Polyset)
IRC R905.3 (clay and concrete tile)

types.label: Slate

components.label: Roofing slate
components.explain: ordered by the square (piece count depends on size and exposure); add waste for breakage and cuts

components.label: #30 felt or heavier / synthetic underlayment
components.explain: #30 or 45 lb felt (or a synthetic) over the whole deck; felt rolls are ~2 squares (synthetic 10)

components.label: Ice and water barrier, eaves and valleys
components.explain: self-adhered along eaves and in valleys in ice-dam regions

components.label: Eave cant strip
components.explain: a thin wood strip along the eave that tilts the starter course; 8 ft pieces

components.label: Starter slates
components.explain: one starter slate laid lengthwise per slate width (~10 in) along every eave

components.label: Ridge and hip slates (saddle or strip)
components.explain: two slates per course, one each side, at ~7 in exposure: ~3.4 per foot of ridge and hip

components.label: Copper ridge / hip cap
components.explain: alternative to slate ridges: 16 oz copper cap in 8 ft pieces

components.label: Copper slating nails
components.explain: 2 copper nails per slate (~350-400 per square for 18x10 at 7.5 in exposure); a 5 lb box does ~1.5 squares

components.label: Slate hooks
components.explain: hook-installed roofs: one stainless or copper hook per slate; boxes of ~1,000

components.label: Copper drip edge
components.explain: along eaves and rakes

components.label: Copper valley flashing (20-24 in)
components.explain: 16 oz copper or stainless valley in every valley; slate valleys must outlast the slate

components.label: Copper step flashing
components.explain: one step per course (~7 in exposure) up sidewalls and chimney sides; 100 pieces do ~55 ft

components.label: Copper apron flashing
components.explain: copper apron along headwalls and the chimney front; 8 ft pieces

components.label: Copper counterflashing
components.explain: copper counterflashing over step and apron flashing

components.label: Concealed ridge vent
components.explain: under a copper ridge where the attic exhausts at the ridge

components.label: Sealant / roof cement
components.explain: slate uses little sealant: ridge setting and flashing details; about one tube per 20 squares

components.label: Copper or lead pipe flashings
components.explain: one per pipe, woven into the courses

components.label: Snow guards
components.explain: in snow regions; slate roofs commonly have them

sources: National Slate Association (NSA) Slate Roofs: Design and Installation Manual
Joseph Jenkins, The Slate Roof Bible
Copper Development Association, Copper in Architecture design handbook (flashings)
IRC R905.6 (slate and slate-type shingles)

types.label: TPO

components.label: Polyiso insulation (4x8)
components.explain: one layer of 4x8 boards (32 sq ft) over the deck; thickness and layers set by the energy code R-value

components.label: Cover board (HD polyiso or gypsum, 4x8)
components.explain: a cover board over insulation or the old roof for a firm, compatible surface

components.label: Insulation fasteners and plates
components.explain: about 8-16 per board by roof zone (~30 per square); boxes of ~1,000

components.label: TPO membrane (60 mil, 10x100)
components.explain: 10 ft x 100 ft rolls; waste covers 6 in seam laps, perimeter sheets and cuts

components.label: Membrane fasteners and seam plates
components.explain: mechanically attached: fasteners every 6-12 in in each seam, closer at the perimeter (~15 per square); boxes of ~500

components.label: Bonding adhesive (fully adhered)
components.explain: alternative to mechanical attachment: a 5 gal pail does about 3 squares (both surfaces coated)

components.label: Wall and curb flashing membrane (24 in)
components.explain: reinforced TPO up every wall and curb at least 8 in; taller walls need wider stock. ~50 ft rolls

components.label: Non-reinforced TPO flashing (corners, penetrations)
components.explain: for field-formed corners and odd penetrations; a 24 in x 50 ft roll does most roofs

components.label: Cut-edge sealant
components.explain: seals cut edges of reinforced membrane at T-joints and details; about one bottle per 20 squares

components.label: Water block / lap sealant
components.explain: a bead behind termination bar and at terminations; ~25 ft per tube

components.label: Single-ply compatible sealant
components.explain: top-of-termination and general sealing; about one tube per 10 squares

components.label: TPO-clad edge metal
components.explain: drip edge / gravel stop along every roof edge (eave and rake lines in the report); 10 ft pieces

components.label: Termination bar
components.explain: termination bar at the top of every wall and curb flashing; 10 ft pieces

components.label: Termination bar fasteners
components.explain: a fastener every 6-8 in along the termination bar; a box of 100 does ~65 ft

components.label: Pre-molded TPO pipe boots
components.explain: one per pipe, heat-welded

components.label: Pre-molded inside/outside corners
components.explain: one per wall/curb corner

components.label: Roof drains / scuppers
components.explain: replace or flash each drain and scupper

components.label: Walkway pads
components.explain: around rooftop equipment

sources: GAF EverGuard TPO Application Guidelines
Carlisle SynTec Sure-Weld TPO specifications and details
Holcim (Firestone) UltraPly TPO technical manual
ANSI/SPRI ES-1 edge securement; NRCA Roofing Manual: Membrane Roof Systems

types.label: PVC

components.label: Polyiso insulation (4x8)
components.explain: one layer of 4x8 boards (32 sq ft) over the deck; thickness and layers set by the energy code R-value

components.label: Cover board (HD polyiso or gypsum, 4x8)
components.explain: a cover board over insulation or the old roof for a firm, compatible surface

components.label: Insulation fasteners and plates
components.explain: about 8-16 per board by roof zone (~30 per square); boxes of ~1,000

components.label: Separation layer / slip sheet
components.explain: PVC must not touch asphalt or EPS foam: a fleece or slip sheet over an old asphalt roof unless new board covers it

components.label: PVC membrane (60 mil, 10x100)
components.explain: 10 ft x 100 ft rolls, hot-air welded; waste covers seam laps, perimeter sheets and cuts

components.label: Membrane fasteners and seam plates
components.explain: mechanically attached: fasteners in every seam, closer at the perimeter (~15 per square); boxes of ~500

components.label: PVC bonding adhesive (fully adhered)
components.explain: alternative to mechanical attachment: a 5 gal pail does about 3 squares

components.label: Wall and curb flashing membrane (24 in)
components.explain: reinforced PVC up every wall and curb; ~50 ft rolls

components.label: Non-reinforced PVC flashing (corners, penetrations)
components.explain: for field-formed corners and odd penetrations

components.label: Water block / lap sealant
components.explain: a bead behind termination bar; ~25 ft per tube

components.label: PVC-compatible sealant
components.explain: about one tube per 10 squares

components.label: PVC-clad edge metal
components.explain: drip edge / gravel stop along every roof edge (eave and rake lines in the report); 10 ft pieces

components.label: Termination bar
components.explain: termination bar at the top of every wall and curb flashing; 10 ft pieces

components.label: Termination bar fasteners
components.explain: a fastener every 6-8 in along the termination bar; a box of 100 does ~65 ft

components.label: Pre-molded PVC pipe boots
components.explain: one per pipe, heat-welded

components.label: Pre-molded inside/outside corners
components.explain: one per wall/curb corner

components.label: Roof drains / scuppers
components.explain: replace or flash each drain and scupper

components.label: Walkway pads
components.explain: around rooftop equipment

sources: Carlisle SynTec Sure-Flex PVC specifications and details
Sika Sarnafil / Johns Manville PVC application guides
GAF EverGuard PVC Application Guidelines
ANSI/SPRI ES-1 edge securement; NRCA Roofing Manual: Membrane Roof Systems

types.label: EPDM

components.label: Polyiso insulation (4x8)
components.explain: one layer of 4x8 boards (32 sq ft) over the deck; thickness and layers set by the energy code R-value

components.label: Cover board (HD polyiso or gypsum, 4x8)
components.explain: a cover board over insulation or the old roof for a firm, compatible surface

components.label: Insulation fasteners and plates
components.explain: about 8-16 per board by roof zone (~30 per square); boxes of ~1,000

components.label: EPDM membrane (60 mil)
components.explain: sized rolls (10 ft and 20 ft widths); 10 squares per 10x100 roll, waste for laps and cuts

components.label: Bonding adhesive
components.explain: fully adhered (the usual residential method): a 5 gal pail does ~3 squares coating both surfaces

components.label: Seam tape (3 in)
components.explain: every side and end lap is taped: ~12 ft of seam per square with 10 ft sheets; 100 ft rolls do ~8 squares

components.label: Seam primer
components.explain: primes laps for tape and flashing; a gallon does about 250-300 ft of 3 in tape (~15 squares with flashings)

components.label: Pressure-sensitive cover strip (6 in)
components.explain: strips the edge metal flange into the membrane along every edge; 100 ft rolls

components.label: Wall and curb flashing (cured EPDM)
components.explain: membrane run up every wall and curb and adhered; ~50 ft of 18-24 in stock per roll

components.label: Uncured EPDM flashing (corners, penetrations)
components.explain: for inside/outside corners and odd penetrations; a 9-12 in x 50 ft roll does most roofs

components.label: Lap sealant
components.explain: a bead along exposed seam edges at flashings and edge strips; ~22 ft per tube

components.label: Water block
components.explain: behind termination bar; ~25 ft per tube

components.label: Membrane fasteners and plates (mechanically attached)
components.explain: only for mechanically attached systems, plus the base-of-wall securement row

components.label: Drip edge / gravel stop
components.explain: drip edge / gravel stop along every roof edge (eave and rake lines in the report); 10 ft pieces

components.label: Termination bar
components.explain: termination bar at the top of every wall and curb flashing; 10 ft pieces

components.label: Termination bar fasteners
components.explain: a fastener every 6-8 in along the termination bar; a box of 100 does ~65 ft

components.label: Pre-molded EPDM pipe boots
components.explain: one per pipe

components.label: Pre-molded inside/outside corners
components.explain: one per wall/curb corner

components.label: Roof drains / scuppers
components.explain: replace or flash each drain and scupper

sources: Carlisle SynTec Sure-Seal EPDM specifications, details and product data (HP-250 primer, SecurTAPE)
Holcim (Firestone) RubberGard EPDM technical manual
ANSI/SPRI ES-1 edge securement; NRCA Roofing Manual: Membrane Roof Systems

types.label: Modified bitumen / torch-down

components.label: Polyiso insulation (4x8)
components.explain: one layer of 4x8 boards (32 sq ft) over the deck; thickness and layers set by the energy code R-value

components.label: Cover board (HD polyiso or gypsum, 4x8)
components.explain: a cover board over insulation or the old roof for a firm, compatible surface

components.label: Insulation fasteners and plates
components.explain: about 8-16 per board by roof zone (~30 per square); boxes of ~1,000

components.label: Base sheet (mechanically fastened)
components.explain: one ply over the deck; base sheet rolls run 1-3 squares by product, 2 is typical

components.label: Base sheet cap nails / plates
components.explain: ~9 in on laps and two staggered rows in the field (~90 per square); a pail does a typical roof

components.label: Granulated cap sheet (SBS or APP)
components.explain: about 1 square per roll; 4 in side and 6 in end laps plus cuts

components.label: Interply / smooth base ply (2-ply over base)
components.explain: commercial 3-ply systems add a smooth ply between base and cap

components.label: Self-adhered base and cap (no torch)
components.explain: residential alternative to torching: self-adhered base and cap, ~1 square per roll each (order per ply)

components.label: Asphalt primer
components.explain: on metal flanges, concrete and under self-adhered sheets; a 5 gal pail does ~6 squares where the whole deck is primed

components.label: Cant strips
components.explain: 45 degree fibre or perlite cant at the base of every wall and curb; 4 ft pieces

components.label: Wall flashing plies (cut from cap and base)
components.explain: two-ply base flashing up walls and curbs; a roll cut into 18 in strips gives ~60 ft

components.label: Modified bitumen flashing cement
components.explain: at laps on flanges, penetrations and terminations; about one tube per 8 squares

components.label: Torch fuel (propane)
components.explain: torch-applied only: a 100 lb cylinder lasts roughly 4 squares of cap and flashing

components.label: Reflective coating
components.explain: only on smooth sheets or for cool-roof upgrades: ~1.5 gal per square, 5 gal pails

components.label: Drip edge / gravel stop
components.explain: drip edge / gravel stop along every roof edge (eave and rake lines in the report); 10 ft pieces

components.label: Termination bar
components.explain: termination bar at the top of every wall and curb flashing; 10 ft pieces

components.label: Termination bar fasteners
components.explain: a fastener every 6-8 in along the termination bar; a box of 100 does ~65 ft

components.label: Pipe flashings (lead or spun aluminium)
components.explain: flanged boot set in cement and stripped in with membrane, one per pipe

components.label: Roof drains / scuppers
components.explain: replace or flash each drain and scupper

sources: GAF Ruberoid / Liberty modified bitumen application guidelines
Johns Manville and Holcim (Firestone) SBS/APP specifications
NRCA Roofing Manual: Membrane Roof Systems; ARMA Quality Manual for low-slope roofing
IRC R905.11 (modified bitumen roofing)
